names.note: The nominative of «Прп. Феофана исп. (ок. 300)» in this folder's Russian citation; «исп.» is the rank and is its own field here.

birth.note: saint.gr: born 283 under Carus and Carinus.

death.note: About 300, azbyka.ru, seventeen years after his release under Carus and Carinus; saint.gr’s birth in 283 cannot sit with it. The Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs (22.09.2026): „мирно скончао 299. год.“
